extraction.name: MINT-1T
extraction.description: A large open-source multimodal interleaved dataset containing free-form sequences of images and text. It includes HTML, PDF, and ArXiv sources and is designed for training large multimodal models.
extraction.creator: Anas Awadalla, Le Xue, Oscar Lo, Manli Shu, Hannah Lee, Etash Guha, Matt Jordan, Sheng Shen, Mohamed Awadalla, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Ran Xu, Yejin Choi, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.publisher: Salesforce Research; University of Washington; Stanford University; University of Texas at Austin; University of California, Berkeley
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by sourcing multimodal documents from CommonCrawl WARC and WAT files and ArXiv LaTeX source code, then parsing, filtering, safety-screening, and deduplicating the documents. HTML documents were extracted from CommonCrawl WARC files by parsing each WARC entry’s DOM tree; PDF documents were sourced from CommonCrawl WAT files by extracting PDF links and downloading/reading the PDFs; ArXiv documents were built from LaTeX source code using TexSoup to interleave figures with text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: CommonCrawl WARC files, CommonCrawl WAT files, and ArXiv LaTeX source code; the final dataset contains HTML tokens, PDF tokens, and ArXiv tokens.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: HTML documents from May 2017 to April 2024; full CommonCrawl dumps from October 2018 to April 2024 and partial dumps from earlier years; PDF documents from February 2023 to April 2024.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors note that they avoid using text quality classifier models because they have been shown to favor text from certain demographics, and they state they take steps to reduce biases and risks in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset relies on external image URLs and is not self-contained; URLs may rot over time, the full dataset is too large to host, and users are encouraged to further filter the data based on their use case. The dataset also contains potentially confidential, offensive, and sensitive content, and should not be used for training models that ingest or generate personally identifying information or for military applications.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to make research into large multimodal models more accessible, but it may also expose confidential, offensive, or sensitive content and could be misused for inappropriate applications involving personal data or military uses.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset may contain personally identifiable information and sensitive attributes such as emails, IP addresses, images of individuals, text about specific individuals, race or ethnic origins, sexual orientations, religious beliefs, political opinions, union memberships, locations, financial or health data, biometric or genetic data, government identification numbers, and criminal history.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Recommended uses include training large multimodal models, generating interleaved image-text sequences, and building multimodal document retrieval systems. The dataset has a training split only. It should not be used to train models that ingest or generate personally identifying information or for military applications.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors will actively maintain the dataset, respond to issues, and publish updates through the Hugging Face README. An erratum will be posted on the dataset README. Older versions remain accessible via Git history, and contributions can be submitted through Hugging Face pull requests.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was preprocessed to remove low quality text, duplicate documents/text portions, and remove not safe for work and low quality images. Specific steps included filtering out non-English documents, documents with NSFW substrings, documents with excessive duplicate n-grams or low quality, removing non-retrievable image links, small/large images and extreme aspect ratio images, anonymizing email and IP addresses, and deduplicating paragraph/document text and images.

name.evidence: “we introduce MINT-1T, the most extensive and diverse open-source Multimodal INTerleaved dataset to date.”

description.evidence: “MINT-1T comprises of one trillion text tokens and 3.4 billion images” and “we include previously untapped sources such as PDFs and ArXiv papers.”

inLanguage.evidence: The paper describes the dataset as containing “HTML/PDFs/ArXiv” and discusses filtering “non-English documents,” but does not explicitly state the dataset language; the content is presented in English.

isLiveDataset.evidence: The paper describes a released dataset and says “We release our data at https://github.com/mlfoundations/MINT-1T,” with no indication of ongoing updates.
